title: WebFPGA (2019)
summary: WebFPGA is a cloud-based FPGA development platform launched in 2019 that enables users to write Verilog HDL code directly in the browser and deploy to real FPGA hardware, eliminating the need for expensive local toolchains and software installations.
problem_solved: Removes the high barrier to entry for FPGA development by eliminating the need for expensive commercial EDA tools and complex local setup.
why_valuable: Democratizes hardware design education by making FPGA development accessible to anyone with a browser and internet connection.
